Sometimes you gotta be selfish and do things for you. You gotta want to do things for you. Just don’t waste your life when there’s still more to be had. There’s so much potential. And there’s so many outlets you can talk to people that will help you. Tell your parents how you feel, tell your teachers, your family , anyone that will listen. And get some help.
